title: The proposed slim v1 importer has no implemented, rehearsed upgrade path
wanted_capability: Move a nonempty v1 state tree into the v2 catalog while preserving identities and proving recovery and the approved rollback guarantee locally.
fallback_used: Keep the v2 mainline release prerequisite open; transfer proposal and review questions to GitHub.
notes: Design remains proposed and release-gated; CLI has genesis but no slim import-v1 command. Unconditional startup retirement/purge conflicts with a byte-identical bridge rollback promise unless guarded or the promise is narrowed. Design decisions remain unresolved. No v1 state inspected or mutated.
